# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io is an incident management product that runs in Slack, described on its homepage as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)) Its GitHub org, incident-io, lists incident.io as its website. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io))

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json is committed in incident-io/on-call-app. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.3. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app))
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io))
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings. ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days. ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update". ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214))
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53". ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198))
- incident.io is hiring a Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native), London or remote UK, posted in "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)". ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), 174 commits, top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app; profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), 92 commits to incident-io/on-call-app; profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), 45 commits to incident-io/on-call-app; profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3))

The evidence does not give titles, locations, or bios for any of them.

## Why now

on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19, and the store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)) ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)) The repo is on react-native 0.74.3 with an open issue tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198))

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 174 commits in on-call-app, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.3. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) There is an open issue about the EAS build failing on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update, and another tracking the upgrade to Expo SDK 53. ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)) ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)) With 5 store releases in the last 90 days, is the Xcode image pin blocking the SDK 53 track, or are those two separate queues for you? ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))
